messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Set the central rectangular cutout side equal to half the box cross-section side; the holes, fillets, and outer dimensions stay the same.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response: {"match": false, "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "The original part is an L-shaped bracket, whereas the instruction implies a box with a central cutout; the edited part changes the geometry from an L-shape to a hollow box, altering the hole position and violating the requirement to preserve features."}
